description:
Workspace-wide propagation of the JMAP-h47t.11 finding from jmap-tasks-server to the canonical jmap-mail-server and the remaining 6 extension-server siblings.

The 30-line match block

  Err(BackendSetError::SetError(set_err)) => not_xxx.insert(id, set_error_value(&set_err)),
  Err(BackendSetError::Other(e)) => not_xxx.insert(id, json!({type: serverFail, description: e})),
  Err(other) => not_xxx.insert(id, json!({type: serverFail, description: other.to_string()})),

appears 8 times in jmap-tasks-server alone (and N more across the 7 siblings). Each is identical modulo the not_xxx target name. Per the cookie-cutter canonical-template rule, extract a shared helper:

  pub(crate) fn map_backend_set_error<E: Display>(err: BackendSetError<E>) -> serde_json::Value {
      match err {
          BackendSetError::SetError(se) => set_error_value(&se),
          BackendSetError::Other(e) => json!({"type": "serverFail", "description": e.to_string()}),
          other => json!({"type": "serverFail", "description": other.to_string()}),
      }
  }

Then each call site collapses from 12 lines (the three Err arms with their inner json!) to 1:

  Err(e) => { not_xxx.insert(id, map_backend_set_error(e)); }

Note: the JMAP-h47t.24 fix already made the catchall Err arm preserve future-variant Display content via other.to_string(). The consolidation here is a code-elegance follow-up, NOT a correctness fix — that's why this sweep is P2 instead of P0/P1.

Canonical-first ordering: change jmap-mail-server's email.rs / mailbox.rs / etc. first, then propagate to tasks/chat/calendars/contacts/filenode/metadata/sharing in matching commits. The helper should live in jmap-server (the foundation crate) since every extension crate needs it; place it next to BackendSetError itself with #[doc(hidden)] or pub depending on whether external consumers writing their own handlers would also want it.

Affected crates (call site count rough):
  jmap-mail-server     ~28 sites (canonical — change first)
  jmap-chat-server     ~15 sites
  jmap-calendars-server ~12 sites
  jmap-tasks-server    ~9 sites (JMAP-h47t.11 closed as deferred-to-this-sweep)
  jmap-contacts-server ~7 sites
  jmap-filenode-server ~6 sites
  jmap-metadata-server ~3 sites
  jmap-sharing-server  ~4 sites

Cross-references:
  - JMAP-h47t.11 closed in favor of this sweep.
  - JMAP-kg3d (BackendSetError catchall placeholder string sweep) is the prerequisite; that one fixes the silent-drop. This one is the cleanup that comes after.
title: workspace canonical-template sweep: consolidate BackendSetError → JSON mapping helper across all *-server crates
